notes:
V4.1.0 — logo plumbing + typography refresh.

🎨  LOGO
• Login window can now display the actual BAPTOU logo image (assets/baptou_logo.png). Until you save the PNG, a typographic fallback renders the same aesthetic — big bold white 'BAPTOU' + thin green '—— TRADING ——' subtitle with bracket lines on each side. Matches the logo's clean look.
• New tools/make_icon.py runs at build time — picks assets/icon.png (or assets/baptou_logo.png as fallback) and produces a multi-size .ico (16/32/48/64/128/256) for the title-bar icon. Auto-crops to square if the source isn't.
• build.bat step [1d/4] regenerates the .ico from the latest PNG on every build, so editing the logo + rebuilding is the entire iteration loop.
• Pillow added to requirements.txt for the PNG conversion. Cryptography also added (was needed by core/secure.py but missing).

TO USE THE ACTUAL LOGO IMAGE (one-time, 30 seconds)
1. Save the BAPTOU logo PNG you have at C:\Users\bapti\Documents\Trade app\assets\baptou_logo.png
2. (Optional, nicer) Save a square-cropped B-graphic-only version at assets/icon.png — gives a cleaner window icon. If skipped, the full logo gets auto-cropped square.
3. Trigger another build — login window shows the image + title bar uses the proper multi-size icon.

Until then v4.1.0 ships with the typographic fallback, which still looks clean.
